evidence.title: Dray README
evidence.locator: intro; Layout; The dray CLI; Releasing
evidence.finding: Desktop home for coding agents wrapping Claude Code, Codex, fx and pi in a native chat UI; many sessions, each with worktree, diff view, PR panel, issue panel and embedded browser; Tauri app (React 19 + Rust), dray CLI over ~/.dray/dray.sock; Apache-2.0 repo.

evidence.title: Dray docs home
evidence.finding: Runs the coding agent CLIs you already use (Claude Code, Codex, pi, fx, Grok Build) in one chat window; free and open source on the subscriptions you already have.

evidence.title: Agents
evidence.locator: What each one supports; Signing in; Claude Code; Codex; pi; fx; Grok Build
evidence.finding: Five agent CLIs side by side with models, effort, permission modes, worktree and mid-turn behaviour; Dray installs no agent and stores no agent login; MCP servers come from each agent configuration.

evidence.title: Install Dray
evidence.locator: Requirements; Download; Install an agent; Dray keeps running after you quit; Limits
evidence.finding: macOS 11+ universal DMG (signed and notarized); Island needs macOS 15; git needed for worktrees; folders without git still work; sessions run in a background process; Chromium for the built-in browser downloads after launch; Mac only (Linux as a server).

evidence.title: Privacy
evidence.locator: What is sent; DRAY_NO_ANALYTICS; Surveys; Other connections
evidence.finding: Anonymous PostHog analytics on by default with no Settings switch, disabled only by DRAY_NO_ANALYTICS; prompts, code, paths and error text never sent; lists other network connections (providers, updates, GitHub/Linear, OpenTunnel, Hugging Face dictation models).

evidence.title: Data on disk
evidence.locator: What is in ~/.dray; What goes when you delete a session; Environment variables
evidence.finding: Everything in ~/.dray (JSONL transcripts, index, attachments, drafts, credentials 0600, browser profiles); deleting a session removes transcript, attachments, browser profile and worktree; DRAY_HOME and DRAY_NO_ANALYTICS variables.

evidence.title: Connect a server
evidence.finding: Linux x86_64/arm64 server over SSH installs Dray as a systemd user service; agents run on the server; used through the Mac app; no browser version and no phone app yet; a Mac cannot be set up over SSH.

evidence.title: Remote access and sharing
evidence.locator: Sessions keep running when you quit; The server list; Remote access; Share a dev server
evidence.finding: Sessions live in a background server (launchd on Mac, systemd on Linux); multiple servers in one sidebar; Remote access via OpenTunnel public address lets another Mac connect with a token; public dev-server links.

evidence.title: Orchestration
evidence.locator: Fan work out; Hidden sessions; Bots; Review with a second model; Messages between sessions
evidence.finding: An agent runs `dray session new` to start child sessions in their own worktrees that inherit agent/model settings; hidden review sessions on another harness with --base; dray session send messages between sessions; Bots with AGENTS.md and memory.

evidence.title: Issues (dray CLI)
evidence.finding: dray issue link records Linear or GitHub issue tags on a session; dray never writes to the tracker.

evidence.title: Issues settings
evidence.locator: Connect a tracker; The Issues page
evidence.finding: Linear (API key) and GitHub (gh) issues browsed in the app; status and priority can be changed from Dray; # tags issues into prompts.

evidence.title: Worktrees
evidence.locator: Start; Where it lives; What it starts from; Delete; Limits
evidence.finding: Worktree sessions at <project>/.claude/worktrees/<name> on worktree-<name> branches from origin default; delete flows warn about uncommitted work; sessions started via dray always get a worktree.

evidence.title: Permissions and questions
evidence.locator: Know when an agent is waiting; Answer a permission request; Approve a plan
evidence.finding: Permission and question cards with Allow once, Always allow, Deny; yellow sidebar mark, macOS notification, Dock badge; plan approval.

evidence.title: Sessions and the sidebar
evidence.locator: Read a row; How the list is ordered
evidence.finding: Sidebar ordered by what needs the user; yellow waiting, green unread, working orb, PR glyph and checks status per session; settle, pin, fork, delete.

evidence.title: Notifications
evidence.locator: What Dray tells you about; Which way you hear; Cards
evidence.finding: macOS banners, in-app cards, sounds for done, needs permission, needs answer and ready to merge.

evidence.title: Accounts
evidence.finding: Per-agent block showing who each agent CLI is signed in as (and gh), with sign-in through Terminal or an API key, sign-out and hiding an agent; no Dray-held agent credentials.

evidence.title: The dray command
evidence.finding: dray CLI installed by the app to ~/.local/bin with an agent skill; talks to the running app or server over a local socket; commands for sessions, drafts, issues, browser, share and servers.

evidence.title: dray session
evidence.finding: dray session new with flags --project, --model, --effort, --harness (claude_code, codex, pi, fx, grok), --base, --title, --issue, --fast and --hidden; run inside a session it nests the new one and inherits settings.

evidence.title: Spaces
evidence.finding: Spaces group projects to separate sessions and notifications; every session keeps running.

evidence.title: Dray llms.txt
evidence.finding: Free open-source macOS app; Apache 2.0; runs on existing subscriptions; Linux supported as a server driven from the Mac app; notch (Island) and on-device dictation.

evidence.title: Apache-2.0 license
evidence.finding: Apache License 2.0.

evidence.title: Tauri configuration
evidence.finding: Tauri macOS app version 0.30.10 with minimumSystemVersion 11.0 and identifier com.yogesh.dray.

evidence.finding: Reads PR checks and review comments through gh and merges with squash/merge/rebase flags through gh pr merge.

evidence.title: Usage events

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
evidence.finding: Only auto_continue (usage-limit retry), updater and transcription match; no user-facing scheduler, cron, webhook or event trigger.

evidence.finding: No roles, teams or SSO in docs; server tokens and an org-link device flow exist but are not user roles.

evidence.finding: No budget or spend cap; usage shown only as reported by harnesses.

evidence.title: Bounded search: native issues
evidence.finding: Issues are read from Linear and GitHub and cached; no Dray-owned issue entity; drafts are saved unstarted tasks.

evidence.finding: Install docs state Mac only and distribute one macOS universal DMG; Linux is supported only as a server; tauri.conf.json sets bundle targets all but no Windows or Linux desktop download is offered; apps/gpui is a client rewrite in progress and apps/island-linux a separate component.

evidence.title: Dray MCP-HELD.md
evidence.locator: first paragraph and The switch section
evidence.finding: States remote MCP is off in release builds until Dray accounts land, with dev builds keeping it; the switch is REMOTE_MCP in dray-proto and ServersSettings.tsx.

evidence.locator: line ~57: pub const REMOTE_MCP: bool = cfg!(debug_assertions)
evidence.finding: REMOTE_MCP is true only when debug assertions are on, so release builds do not serve the /mcp routes.

evidence.finding: Dray sends anonymous usage events; set DRAY_NO_ANALYTICS to send nothing. 'Older versions had a Share basic analytics switch in Settings. A choice saved there is no longer read.'
